label: A01
title: Анимационно-удобный двор
scene: Open square stone courtyard, rear gate, short broken walls; four figures: shield knight, green hooded archer, purple mage, horned monster.
prompt: Edit ONLY the white mask containing the single simplified blue shield knight at courtyard upper left. Repose this ONE figure into a strong BACK-THREE-QUARTER elevated isometric view facing the upper-right diagonal tile axis. Show the broad BACK of the helmet and torso plus one SIDE plane of the helmet, shield and body; visor, face and front chest must NOT be visible. Align both shoulders, hips, arms, equipment, boots and both soles along that same diagonal. Preserve the identity and equipment: simple blue helmet, round shield, compact solid hands and boots. Preserve the exact compact scale and same foot anchor, with both soles inside its one full original diamond tile; no widening into neighboring cells. Keep crisp stepped pixels, palette, dark outlines, contact shadow and the original continuous room grid. Preserve every black-mask pixel exactly. Do not add a character, base, pedestal, platform, ring, glow or UI.
hypothesis: Simplified large solid forms and clean separation might reduce future animation artifacts. Static art alone cannot establish motion stability.
animation_artifact_reduction: Hypothesis only; no motion generation or stability test was performed.
